title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Benefits: Tier Reduction on Free Night Awards Rebooked Nights
content:
Gold Elite, Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite and Ambassador Elite members see a lower rebooked night's price when they apply one of the Free Night Awards that came back from a cancelled stay to a night of another Reward Night Rate reservation. The tier reduction is the upper rebooking tier reduction for a Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite member, the lower rebooking tier reduction for a Gold Elite or Platinum Elite member, and nothing for every other member. The tier reduction is taken off the rebooked night's price once.

| Tier currently held on the Ashbury Rewards membership | Tier reduction on the rebooked night |
|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite or Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite | 3000 points (upper rebooking tier reduction) |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite or Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | 1500 points (lower rebooking tier reduction) |
| Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite or Ashbury Rewards Member | No tier reduction |

**Which tier counts?** The elite tier the membership record shows as currently held.

**Does a Silver Elite member receive a smaller reduction?** No. Silver Elite is among every other member, and no tier reduction applies.
